title: LSAT preparation and law school applications
audience: a pre-law college student (any major) preparing for law school and the LSAT
purpose: Master LSAT Logical Reasoning and Reading Comprehension question types under time, practice the LSAT Argumentative Writing task, and prepare law school applications: personal statement, résumé, recommendations and school selection.
primary_reading: LSAC: LSAT prep and LawHub (free official practice tests)

weeks.1: The LSAT and how it is scored
weeks.6: Principle, parallel reasoning and method questions
weeks.11: Choosing schools and paying for law school

blocks.deliverable: Take a timed diagnostic set and log every miss.
Do 30 assumption and flaw questions with an error log.
Week 7 midterm; complete two timed passages and map their structure.
Write a timed argumentative essay and score it against the rubric.
Draft a personal statement and a school list with reasons.
Submit the project; take an unseen 120 minute final in week 14.

project: Application file: a timed practice set from the course materials, an error-log analysis of your patterns, a final personal statement of about 650 words, a one-page résumé and a school list with reasons.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
